checks.description: Actual index with synthetic credentials prepares a grounded timer, an injected unknown request with retained budget and an admitted queued root through authenticated production HTTP; both release controls close before normal shutdown.

Observe actual-index restart preserves all threaded table hashes at startup and exposes authenticated history, waits, release snapshots, timeline and pure routing preview without decryption or model transport.
All nine authenticated observe mutation categories reject before business changes, including release, message, routing, lifecycle, approval and Decision controls.

A naturally elapsed five-second timer, explicit notification/wakeup/recovery/startDispatch hints and background intervals leave all threaded tables, shared resource tables except availability hints, unknown claim/usage and callbacks unchanged; no credentials decrypt and no transport occurs. Pending work prevents drain-ready.

Closed actual index with retained pack refuses new threaded rooms and roots, while an exact prior admitted-message retry returns its original receipt; dispatch remains explicitly paused and never decrypts credentials.

Closed retains HTTP history reads and durable room/run/message/manual-task writes for pipeline, supervisor and collaboration, plus new empty legacy rooms; threaded conversations remain hidden from legacy routes and unknown budgets remain reserved. This is not legacy model-execution acceptance.
